description: Derived extractions for Sysmon (winlog.channel == 'Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational'): a native ECS mapping of its operational channel over the canonical winlog.* model, so Sysmon events land beside the other channels under one schema. Two steps: (1) classify event.category/type per Sysmon EventID; (2) project winlog.data.* onto ECS per EventID family — process create/terminate (1,5), process access/inject (8,10,25), network connection (3), DNS query (22), image/driver load (6,7), file create/delete/pipe (2,11,15,17,18,23,26), registry (12,13,14) — parsing the Hashes blob into process/file hash.* (+ pe.imphash) and the DOMAIN\user string into user.domain/user.name. The native winlog.data.* stays in place.

script.source: def id = ctx.winlog.event_id; def M = ['1':['process','start'],'2':['file','change'],'3':['network','connection'],'4':['configuration',null],'5':['process','end'],'6':['driver',null],'7':['library',null],'8':['process',null],'9':['process',null],'10':['process',null],'11':['file','creation'],'12':['registry','creation'],'13':['registry','change'],'14':['registry','change'],'15':['file','creation'],'17':['file','creation'],'18':['file',null],'22':['network',null],'23':['file','deletion'],'24':['file',null],'25':['process',null],'26':['file','deletion']]; def e = M.get(id); if (e != null) { if (!(ctx.event instanceof Map)) { ctx.event = [:]; } if (e[0] != null && ctx.event.category == null) { ctx.event.category = e[0]; } if (e[1] != null && ctx.event.type == null) { ctx.event.type = e[1]; } }

script.description: project Sysmon winlog.data.* onto ECS per EventID family; hash blob and DOMAIN\user parsed
script.source: boolean real(def v) { return v instanceof String && v.length() > 0 && v != '-'; } void put(def root, List path, def v) { if (!real(v)) { return; } def cur = root; for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) { if (!(cur[path[i]] instanceof Map)) { cur[path[i]] = [:]; } cur = cur[path[i]]; } if (cur[path[path.size() - 1]] == null) { cur[path[path.size() - 1]] = v; } } def hexv(def v) { if (v instanceof String && v.length() > 0) { try { if (v.startsWith('0x') || v.startsWith('0X')) { return Long.parseLong(v.substring(2), 16); } return Long.parseLong(v); } catch (Exception e) { return null; } } return null; } void putpid(def root, List path, def v) { def n = hexv(v); if (n == null) { return; } def cur = root; for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) { if (!(cur[path[i]] instanceof Map)) { cur[path[i]] = [:]; } cur = cur[path[i]]; } if (cur[path[path.size() - 1]] == null) { cur[path[path.size() - 1]] = n; } } void hashes(def root, def base, def s) { if (!(s instanceof String) || s.length() == 0) { return; } for (def part : s.splitOnToken(',')) { int eq = part.indexOf('='); if (eq > 0) { def alg = part.substring(0, eq).toLowerCase(); def val = part.substring(eq + 1); if (val.length() > 0) { def p; if (alg == 'imphash') { p = [base, 'pe', 'imphash']; } else { p = [base, 'hash', alg]; } put(root, p, val); } } } } void setuser(def root, def v) { if (!(v instanceof String) || v.length() == 0 || v == '-' || v.startsWith('%%')) { return; } int ix = v.lastIndexOf(Character.toString((char)92)); if (ix >= 0) { put(root, ['user','domain'], v.substring(0, ix)); put(root, ['user','name'], v.substring(ix + 1)); } else { put(root, ['user','name'], v); } } def d = ctx.winlog.data; def id = ctx.winlog?.event_id; if (id == '1') { putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.Image); put(ctx, ['process','command_line'], d.CommandLine); put(ctx, ['process','working_directory'], d.CurrentDirectory); put(ctx, ['process','entity_id'], d.ProcessGuid); put(ctx, ['process','pe','original_file_name'], d.OriginalFileName); hashes(ctx, 'process', d.Hashes); putpid(ctx, ['process','parent','pid'], d.ParentProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','parent','executable'], d.ParentImage); put(ctx, ['process','parent','command_line'], d.ParentCommandLine); put(ctx, ['process','parent','entity_id'], d.ParentProcessGuid); setuser(ctx, d.User); } else if (id == '5') { putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.Image); put(ctx, ['process','entity_id'], d.ProcessGuid); } else if (id == '8' || id == '10') { putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.SourceProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.SourceImage); put(ctx, ['process','entity_id'], d.SourceProcessGuid); } else if (id == '25') { putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.Image); } else if (id == '3') { put(ctx, ['source','ip'], d.SourceIp); putpid(ctx, ['source','port'], d.SourcePort); put(ctx, ['destination','ip'], d.DestinationIp); putpid(ctx, ['destination','port'], d.DestinationPort); putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.Image); setuser(ctx, d.User); if (real(d.Protocol)) { if (!(ctx.network instanceof Map)) { ctx.network = [:]; } if (ctx.network.transport == null) { ctx.network.transport = d.Protocol.toLowerCase(); } } if (d.Initiated == 'true' || d.Initiated == 'false') { if (!(ctx.network instanceof Map)) { ctx.network = [:]; } if (ctx.network.direction == null) { ctx.network.direction = (d.Initiated == 'true') ? 'egress' : 'ingress'; } } } else if (id == '22') { put(ctx, ['dns','question','name'], d.QueryName); putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.Image); setuser(ctx, d.User); } else if (id == '6') { put(ctx, ['file','path'], d.ImageLoaded); hashes(ctx, 'file', d.Hashes); } else if (id == '7') { put(ctx, ['file','path'], d.ImageLoaded); hashes(ctx, 'file', d.Hashes); putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.Image); } else if (['2','11','15','23','26'].contains(id)) { put(ctx, ['file','path'], d.TargetFilename); putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.Image); setuser(ctx, d.User); } else if (id == '17' || id == '18') { put(ctx, ['file','name'], d.PipeName); putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.Image); } else if (id == '12' || id == '13' || id == '14') { put(ctx, ['registry','path'], d.TargetObject); putpid(ctx, ['process','pid'], d.ProcessId); put(ctx, ['process','executable'], d.Image); }
